Arm census

Every minimum-time motion of the six-joint arm benchmark, as the solver finds it. Each case is a jerk-limited move with a torque limit on every joint; the vgoal and vrest cases repeat the others with a limit on every joint's rate as well, and the p cases (pgoal, prest, pvgoal, pvrest) cap the joints whose answer swings past its start-to-goal range with a position limit. The o cases put an obstacle in a rest motion's way: a sphere it grazes (ograze), a sphere squarely in its path (oblock) or a wall it must get over or around (owall); the elbow, forearm, wrist and tool must all clear it. A trace turns red where its joint rides its limit. Unsolved cases show the start pose (faint) and the goal pose (grey).

Drag the arm to turn the view.
